verdict.rationale: Orb documents a hosted first-party MCP server at mcp.withorb.com using Streamable HTTP and bearer-key auth. It exposes 100+ Orb API operations as tools, with scope-controlled keys and a test-mode key option for isolated experimentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate successfully against the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: It exposes 100+ Orb API operations as tools, covering customers, subscriptions, plans and prices, billable metrics, invoices, credits, alerts, licenses, event search and price evaluation
To try things out without touching live billing data, create the key in **test mode**.
